value_differences.gold_value: Preserve the independently supported sibling branch and any stable background context.
value_differences.model_value: state:secondary and its directly associated edge:secondary_support and unknown:secondary are preserve_focus items and must not be revised. Background branch state:bg_1 and its associated edge and unknown are unchanged and remain stable context.

value_differences.gold_value: Track the new competing-cause evidence and preserve any independently supported sibling branch.
value_differences.model_value: edge:primary_support weakened from strong to medium due to competing alternate cause introduction via evidence:alternate. New edge:alternate_support added linking evidence:alternate to state:primary as supports_alternate_explanation. New state:hop3_dependency added as revise_focus branch with evidence:hop3. New edge:hop3_dependency added creating downstream dependency to scenario:hop3_escalation. scenario:hop3_escalation introduced at rank 1, displacing scenario:primary to rank 2 and scenario:alternate to rank 3. Two new unknowns added: unknown:dominant_cause and unknown:hop3_dependency.

value_differences.gold_value: A model that misses the new competing-cause branch has stopped too early. A model that rewrites the preserved sibling branch without contrary evidence has over-revised.
value_differences.model_value: Under-revision failure: failing to weaken edge:primary_support or failing to add the alternate cause and hop3 structures when evidence:alternate and evidence:hop3 are introduced; over-revision failure: modifying the preserved state:secondary branch or its associated edge and unknown despite no contrary evidence being introduced against it.
